classes.name: CheckoutModel
classes.description: Page model handling the checkout process, including basket retrieval, order creation, and cookie management.

methods.name: .ctor
methods.description: Constructor that initializes dependencies via dependency injection.

methods.name: get_BasketModel
methods.description: Property getter for the basket view model.

methods.name: OnGet
methods.description: Handles GET requests to load the checkout page, initializes basket model.

methods.name: OnPost
methods.description: Handles POST requests to process checkout actions, including order creation and basket deletion.

methods.name: SetBasketModelAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously sets up the BasketModel property, retrieving or creating the basket based on user state.

methods.name: GetOrSetBasketCookieAndUserName
methods.description: Retrieves or creates the basket cookie and username for identifying the user's basket.
